Container.Name: leyline-inbox
Container.Overview: Takes addon links from your phone and puts them in your Leyline wishlist. Part of Leyline, the WoW settings and addon sync. Keep it private: reach it through Tailscale, never forward its port to the internet.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: A secret of at least 8 characters. The phone sends it with every link.

Config.Name: Inbox folder
Config.Description: The 'inbox' folder inside your Leyline NAS folder: /mnt/user/SHARE/FOLDER/inbox
